verdict.rationale: New Relic docs describe APM agents adding metadata for 'logs in context' so logs can be seen in relevant platform views, and log management is positioned to reduce MTTR by linking events, errors, traces together — supporting cross-signal correlation. However, the pack lacks explicit documentation of a trace-span-to-logs/metrics UI jump workflow or independent confirmation it works smoothly in practice. Missing for 10: explicit trace-span drill-down UI documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of the correlation workflow, metrics correlation specifics beyond logs.
